question: Which animals were the first in space?
short_answer: Fruit flies launched by the United States aboard a V-2 rocket on February 20, 1947, were the first animals sent into space, reaching an altitude of 68 miles (109 km) to study radiation exposure.
full_explanation: The fruit flies were recovered alive via parachute. Following fruit flies, the U.S. launched rhesus monkeys (Albert series) and the Soviet Union launched stray dogs to test survival in upper atmosphere and space environments.
